p4TakePicture.summary: Requests a still image and waits for completion. Keep its handle and release it after use.
p4TakePicture.returns: Image handle, or 0 when request fails.
prerequisites: Import P4 Camera and its declared dependencies.

examples.title: Use take picture
examples.explanation: Block notation: Requests a still image and waits for completion. Keep its handle and release it after use. Image handle, or 0 when request fails.

notes: Native Zephyr camera and portable images. Four immutable images, 8 MiB total: release when finished. Sizes are width x height in pixels. Resize uses nearest neighbor. Smooth resize/rotate/flip use P4 PPA on RGB565/RGB888; smooth scale ratios must be multiples of 1/16. Check image processing status for unsupported input or errors. Preview/export stays in this browser. Pi Camera v2.1 / IMX219 manual settings are RAM-only: exposure 4..1156 lines, analogue register 0..232, digital register 256..4095. Reset/reboot restores 800/128/256. Busy/unsupported/invalid changes return false. Snapshot uses current applied settings, returns a 320x180 image and opens preview; release its handle when finished. Sliders also show the exact tuple used. No automatic exposure, white balance or motorized focus.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32p4_wifi6\integration\P4_Camera.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
